title: Block Movement / stack / 32069
description: Which sequence produces the entire final stack?
question: Use the 3 x 2 x 2 board. Each pair shows the same stack from opposite sides. Coordinates (x,y,z) follow the axes, starting at zero. Move the cube at the named current cell one unit. An occupied target swaps with the mover. An empty elevated target needs support immediately before the move. After each step, settle every column downward, preserving its order. Equal colors are interchangeable. Which sequence produces the entire final stack?

answer.explanation: magenta (2, 0, 0) to (2, 1, 0), exchanging with gold. Then gold (2, 0, 1) to (2, 1, 1). Then gold (2, 0, 0) to (2, 1, 0), exchanging with magenta. Every displayed constraint matches.

options.label: A
options.explanation: gold (1, 1, 0) to (2, 1, 0), exchanging with gold. Then gold (2, 0, 1) to (2, 1, 1). Then gold (1, 1, 0) to (0, 1, 0). Step 3, cell (0, 1, 0) contains gold. The panel requires empty.

options.label: B
options.explanation: magenta (2, 0, 0) to (2, 1, 0), exchanging with gold. Then gold (2, 0, 1) to (2, 1, 1). Then gold (2, 0, 0) to (2, 1, 0), exchanging with magenta. Every displayed constraint matches.

options.explanation: gold (2, 1, 0) to (2, 1, 1), gold falls from (2, 1, 1) to (2, 1, 0). Then gold (2, 0, 1) to (2, 1, 1). Then gold (1, 1, 0) to (1, 0, 0). Step 3, cell (1, 0, 0) contains gold. The panel requires empty.

options.explanation: magenta (2, 0, 0) to (2, 1, 0), exchanging with gold. Then magenta (2, 1, 0) to (2, 1, 1), magenta falls from (2, 1, 1) to (2, 1, 0). Then gold (2, 0, 0) to (2, 1, 0), exchanging with magenta. Step 3, cell (2, 0, 1) contains gold. The panel requires empty.
